items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: when you first played with Papa Lane... He called it the Reliance band, yes. Reliance. And I called it Jack, Jack Lane. Yes.

ctx.x: Somebody told me he had more than one band.
Yeah, he had a couple bands, yeah. They called it Babies or something, wasn't it? Huh? Was it Papa Lane, these Babies or something like that? Name, that's all I know when he was right down there.
Was he always, he didn't play in all of them, of course, if he had more than one band, did he send somebody else out as leader, or did he appoint? Yeah, he'd go higher, higher, you see.
